question: The aviation sector in India was inaugurated with the introduction of Tata Airlines in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1932.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tata Airlines,** which later became **Air India**, was founded by** J.R.D. Tata in 1932** as a private airline.
 
• It operated its first flight from** Karachi to Mumbai **on October 15,** 1932.**
 
• Tata Airlines was initially focused on **mail delivery**, but it later expanded its services to include **passenger transportation.**
 
• The aviation sector in India has come a long way since 1932, with the country having one of the** fastest-growing aviation markets** in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's flag carrier airline is called** Air India**.
 
• With **102 local and international** destinations served, its fleet of Airbus and Boeing aircraft is operated by the company.
 
• Its main office is in **Gurugram.**
 
• Delhi's** Indira Gandhi International Airport** serves as the airline's primary hub.
 
• After IndiGo, the airline is the **second-largest passenger carrier** in India as of July 2023.
 
• On July 11, 2014, Air India joined** Star Alliance** as its **27th member.**
